node.title: Re: 32bit/64bit hash function: Use perls internal hash function?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
To answer your question directly, [doc://perlapi#PERL_HASH|PERL_HASH] is exposed by [doc://B]:

$ perl -MB=hash -le 'print hash("foo")' 0xad6987c4 $ perl -MB=hash -le 'print hash("foo")' 0x5fd458f7

But as I [id://11142823|said], you may want to consider using a standardized function, which when implemented in XS should be "nearly as fast". Also, keep in mind that in hashes, collisions are acceptable - short checksums will do that, and since you haven't told us anything about the problem you're trying to solve, we can't know if that is appropriate in your case.
